values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754247 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754247 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 25ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754247 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet, drinking water, primitive campsites and a gravel boat ramp; 'Difficult Accessibility'. Site is 31.87 acres.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754247 (Facilities: 'Toilet', 'Drinking Water', 'Primitive Campsite', 'Ramp (Gravel)'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'; Size '31.87 acres'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Blackfoot River with designated primitive camping (Region 2). Directions (FWP): 25.5 miles east of Bonner on Hwy 200, turn west (just before mile marker 27) on Ninemile Prairie road for 6 miles. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping (with/without fishing license), 25-ft trailer limit, 7-day stay limit (added to booking), drinking water, toilet, primitive campsites, gravel ramp; open-all-year season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of the restated facilities, length, stay limit, FCFS and fee text.
